## How discovery moves

```{=html}
<div class="research-grid">
  <article class="research-card">
    <span class="research-step">01 / Design</span>
    <h3>Imagine the molecule</h3>
    <p>Generative models propose new three-dimensional candidates, guided by
    target shape and chemical feasibility.</p>
  </article>
  <article class="research-card">
    <span class="research-step">02 / Predict</span>
    <h3>Find the standouts</h3>
    <p>Machine learning prioritises candidates by predicted activity, properties
    and safety signals.</p>
  </article>
  <article class="research-card">
    <span class="research-step">03 / Simulate</span>
    <h3>See how it behaves</h3>
    <p>Molecular dynamics follows molecules as they move and interact with their
    protein targets over time.</p>
  </article>
  <article class="research-card">
    <span class="research-step">04 / Make &amp; test</span>
    <h3>Make it measurable</h3>
    <p>Synthetic chemistry and biological assays turn promising designs into
    compounds and experimental results.</p>
  </article>
</div>
```

::: {.research-outlook}
[Where we focus]{.eyebrow}

## New targets. New possibilities.

Our published work has a strong focus on cancer-relevant targets, especially
histone deacetylases. The same combination of AI, simulation and chemistry can
be applied to new therapeutic questions.

[Explore our publications](publications.html)
:::
